evidence.quote: We propose a $38 million class fund, distributed automatically to all identified class members, plus $1 million for court-approved attorneys’ fees and expenses.
We propose bridging the remaining economic gap at $29 million in automatic, nonreversionary class payments, plus $1 million in court-reviewed fees and expenses
Reallocating $1 million from fees to members achieves our $29 million class target within defense's stated $31 million overall ceiling.
We are willing to reduce the proposed fee allocation to improve members’ guaranteed recovery, not reduce Brightline’s total commitment.

summary: Plaintiffs first raised attorneys’ fees in their opening settlement proposals, and fee amounts were negotiated while class relief and implementation terms remained unsettled. The transcript explicitly links fees and class relief when Ostrander reallocates $1 million from fees to increase guaranteed member recovery. There is no clear evidence that class counsel prioritized firm compensation over the class, that defense exploited fee interests as a lever, that a reverse auction occurred, or that any court declaration was misleading.
